_discipline: All facts here are backed by real Phase 0 spike runs, not model memory. Spike scripts/raw outputs live outside the repo (control_root). Every value cites its evidence.
_sanitized: No tokens, auth files, or sensitive absolute paths are committed; only sanitized command shapes, versions, and output structures.

versions._note: portalocker/pytest-mock were installed during the spike (not pre-installed); mcp SDK is the OFFICIAL 'mcp' package under site-packages, not a local dir.

zcode._summary: How ZCode loads an MCP server and calls a tool — discovered via Task 0.1.

plugin_loaded.evidence: echo MCP server registered in ~/.zcode/cli/config.json -> mcp.servers.echo-spike (stdio). ZCode auto-connects user-scope MCP servers at session start. Verified: the server was connected and its tool was callable from the interactive session.
plugin_loaded._note: Config-file MCP servers do NOT expand ${...} templates — absolute paths required (plugin-provided servers do expand templates).

mcp_stdio.evidence: Official mcp SDK client (stdio_client + ClientSession) drove initialize -> tools/list -> tools/call against echo/server.py directly; all three succeeded.

config_file_mcp.shape: mcp.servers.<name> = { type:'stdio', command:<abs path>, args:[<abs paths>], env:{...}, enabled?, timeoutMs? }
config_file_mcp.template_expansion: NONE for config-file servers; absolute paths required

plugin_manifest.mcpServers_shape: <name>: { command, args[], cwd, env } — plugins DO expand ${ZCODE_PROJECT_DIR}/${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/${user_config.KEY}
plugin_manifest.observed_real_example: android-emulator/ios-simulator plugins in the official cache

sdk_import_path.evidence: importlib.util.find_spec('mcp.server.fastmcp') -> FOUND; origin under site-packages, NOT under repo. No local mcp/ shadow (G2 trap avoided).

echo_tool_call.evidence: In a real interactive ZCode session, PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks captured tool_name='mcp__echo-spike__echo' with tool_input={text:'hello'} and toolResponse.content[0].text='{"echo": "hello"}', isError=false.
